notes: Version 2.54 records white paper 3.19. The white paper fixes one dimensional convention for its substrate constants: χ_c is a length and K_0, the rate constant of the discrete admissibility rule, has dimension s^-2, so that ħ_χ = c^3/(K_0 χ_c) is an action per unit mass (m^2 s^-1). No action can be formed from c, χ_c and K_0 alone; the identification ħ = M_χ ħ_χ is conditional on a mass scale M_χ that is not supplied. In that convention a relation K_0 χ_c^2 ~ c^4/(16πG) is not dimensionally consistent, and no numerical value of K_0 or ħ_χ is established. A scale dependence ħ_eff ∝ (χ_c/ℓ)^2 is excluded by flux quantisation and the observed Josephson effect; the order-of-magnitude checks of Appendix D.3 keep the electron-scale eigenvalue target, which does not fix K_0, and the electroweak calibration χ_c ~ ħc/v; the black-hole temperature is a structural reading of the Hawking surface-gravity form. The description of the white-paper graph node is updated; no paper status or edge changes.
